wire_contract.aggregation: issues are exact sorted unique reason strings, aggregated across all independently valid branches and all target rows. TYPE_RECORD_UNAVAILABLE and SYNTHETIC_AUTHORITY_UNQUALIFIED do not short-circuit other failures. Invalid branch shape records WIRE_PROFILE_INVALID and does not traverse ill-typed descendants; independent branches are still checked. Duplicate identity refuses before canonical sorting. Reason strings never enter core.

decoder.depth: Root object/list depth=1; scalar root depth=0. Check structural depth before schema validation; 65 nested containers is depth error.
decoder.errors: ValueError; lexical category wins before shape refusal. Duplicate including nested => duplicate; nonfinite tokens/overflow => finite; >limit => size/limit/large; depth>64 => depth; trailing JSON => trailing/extra data. No AssertionError-based validation.
decoder.policy_pin: expected_sha256 exact lower64hex equals SHA256 of exact raw bytes before semantic acceptance; whitespace retained in raw pin; strict lexical malformed input still refuses.

joins: membership.side base resolves exactly request.base B; candidate resolves exactly request.checked_merge S. membership.snapshot equals the whole corresponding CommitRef. All non-origin Source refs match snapshot repository/commit; native mode=100644 and all six GitRef fields join their retained raw bytes/SHA/framed Git blob. Origin refs retain all six immutable fields and may not be relabelled snapshot.

Every role_input and target_input GitRef equals a retained source full GitRef, including commit. Record manifest/module/scope/origin/checked-copy/lock/producer refs equal full retained refs. Repeated repository/path references agree. Snapshot projection alone drops commit; original refs remain complete.

Decode raw native_manifest; derive package from package string plus manifest path; target names from all object targets, including zero-link/unlinked target. native_targets and records exhaust that set exactly once. target.module resolves package_root/module and belongs to native source_modules. Raw root module imports preserve source_modules order.

Every raw native files entry joins candidate source bytes/SHA; complete fixture candidate source set equals files plus all unbound_files, including exact manifest and unbound ALIGNMENT.md. Every native origin resolves retained origin, equal checked local copy and verbatim informal anchor. Main origin/local-copy fields remain native seven-field form; full GitRefs are separate.

Raw toolchain equals manifest/producer/records toolchain. Raw lock packages name/rev set equals native dependency_revisions object, membership.native_dependencies, producer observation, policy dependency revision set and every compiler_context dependency_revisions. No shortened revision or duplicate name.

NativeProducerPolicy workflow+supervisor_source_refs equals complete producer source set; source_control_files equals full held build/producer/scope/import/target enumerations. Native bound minimum build/files, root/source module and scope inputs are not guessed from changed files.

Parse raw producer_observation and require equality with membership.producer_observation; all compiler executable/version/runtime named refs resolve raw sources and byte identities. options/print_options match producer observation and every context/policy/effective membership value in exact order; runtime null image only under non-image kind.

Resolve each target import closure from literal native Lean import lines to registered package modules; compare complete direct/transitive imported refs excluding own module against target_inputs and global import union. No empty guessed import set.

Acceptance links enumerate exact synthetic known link IDs. Both selector arrays per target have identical IDs, with source content equal the resolved target module, exact bounds and raw slice SHA. Known zero links yields both empty arrays. Missing links/qualification is unknown and never an empty accepted set.

ordering.projection: Sort only declared unordered content arrays into accepted canonical target/dependency/source-role/runtime/selector order, after uniqueness and full joins. Preserve ordered option/print-option strings byte-for-byte. Canonical inventory_sha256 boundary refuses unsorted core arrays; it does not silently sort them.

primitive_rules.base64: exact canonical standard base64 with strict validation and encode(decode(value)) equality
primitive_rules.enum: both exact Python/JSON scalar type and value must match one member; true never equals 1
primitive_rules.name: ASCII [A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_.']*
primitive_rules.path: exact nonempty relative normalized POSIX repository path; no empty/dot/dotdot segments, leading slash, backslash, URL, NUL or control characters
primitive_rules.positive_int: type(value) is int and value>0; bool excluded
primitive_rules.repository: ASCII owner/repo, each component nonempty, no URL or slash beyond separator
primitive_rules.uint: type(value) is int and value>=0; bool excluded

qualification_rules: Synthetic non-type fields are structurally projected only after complete raw/source/role/native/producer/selector joins. Their presence is never native qualification. Both type fields are null and are the only unresolved_fields in the held baseline.

This boundary accepts only SYNTHETIC_STRUCTURE_ONLY plus explicit UNQUALIFIED values. Native_context/type_record remain null. A native_qualified/authenticated/accepted flag, changed qualifier or unknown acceptance is refused; changing a label cannot select a production authority path.

Every content_inventory result in this synthetic boundary has formal_inventory_sha256=null, including fully materialized structural inputs. Diagnostic SHA is precisely the accepted canonical core formula. SYNTHETIC_AUTHORITY_UNQUALIFIED remains an issue outside core.

Actual M1/M2, native service membership, type original and accepted mapping/review authority are absent. Production needs separately authenticated native inputs and reviewed profile; it cannot earn authority from this fixture schema or booleans.

reason_actions.DEPENDENCY_SET_MISMATCH: Keep identity-complete core only with compiler_dependency_options_identity null and exact unresolved field.
reason_actions.DUPLICATE_TARGET_IDENTITY: Repeated native identity, even identical; no core/digests.
reason_actions.IMPORT_SET_MISMATCH: Raw import closure and complete per-target import inputs disagree: scope_content_identity null/listed.
reason_actions.NATIVE_MANIFEST_PROJECTION_MISMATCH: Raw package/module/files/source/manifest cached projection disagrees; no core/digests.
reason_actions.PRODUCER_CONTEXT_MISMATCH: Raw producer observation/options/print/runtime/source context disagree: compiler_dependency_options_identity null/listed.
reason_actions.SELECTOR_ACCEPTANCE_UNRESOLVED: Missing/unknown links or qualifier: both accepted_formal_*_selector fields null/listed, never empty guess.
reason_actions.SELECTOR_BYTES_MISMATCH: Bad selector source/bounds/slice SHA: affected selector field null/listed.
reason_actions.SELECTOR_LINK_SET_MISMATCH: Foreign/duplicate/inconsistent accepted link ID or target: both selector fields null/listed.
reason_actions.SOURCE_BYTES_MISMATCH: Bad raw length/SHA/Git blob: affected content field null/listed; if manifest affected, no core/digests.
reason_actions.SOURCE_MEMBERSHIP_MISMATCH: Wrong full snapshot/ref join: affected module/compiler/scope/selector field null/listed; if manifest or native snapshot identity affected, no core/digests.
reason_actions.SOURCE_ROLE_ENUMERATION_UNRESOLVED: Missing/unknown/omitted complete role input: scope/import affects scope_content_identity; build/producer affects compiler_dependency_options_identity; each affected field null/listed.
reason_actions.SOURCE_ROLE_MISMATCH: Origin/snapshot role relabel: affected module/compiler/scope/selector field null/listed; if manifest affected, no core/digests.
reason_actions.SYNTHETIC_AUTHORITY_UNQUALIFIED: Always present in this synthetic boundary; formal digest null; no added unresolved field because all such values are structural-only, not native admission.
reason_actions.SYNTHETIC_NATIVE_EVIDENCE_REFUSED: Synthetic-only boundary received nonnull native_context/type_record or native qualification: no core/digests.
reason_actions.TYPE_RECORD_UNAVAILABLE: type_content_bytes/type_content_sha256 null on every record without qualified type; list both field names.
reason_actions.WIRE_PROFILE_INVALID: Closed/type malformed input; no accepted core/digests. A more specific missing enum/role/acceptance reason below takes precedence for that location.

wire_contract.scope: Concrete proposed internal fixture wire types. DiagnosticPolicy is a strict subprofile of accepted Policy. No production authentication/admission interface is implemented or supplied.
shape_rules: All object fields mandatory, exact and closed recursively. No defaulting/coercion/unknown-field ignore.

Arrays exact lists; min/max inclusive. unique_by=[] means unique canonical whole values; named paths mean unique canonical tuple of named field values. Unordered means input order is insignificant; it does not permit duplicates.
Union has exactly one valid branch. Nullable permits null or exactly its named item. Maps have only keys satisfying key primitive and values satisfying named type.

NativeManifest is the retained supported Main structural subset, with unchanged six-field object targets, seven-field origins, native package string, dependency object and ordered source_modules/targets. It supplies no extra native qualification fields.
wire_contract.unknown_behavior: No missing field is defaulted to empty/false/accepted. Unavailable required content is null with its exact field name in sorted unique unresolved_fields and diagnostic-only digest if identity enumeration remains complete. Unknown identity/native enumeration yields core/digests null. Untrusted/malformed wire cannot be an accepted diagnostic substitute. Known absence is explicit zero links or selector:null on a known link, never missing acceptance.
